set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-research.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: After the frozen development candidate and all declared comparisons, perform the single guarded Friends/Memento test opening under the unchanged manifest, multiplicity and read-count rules. Retain negative/unavailable results and prohibit post-opening retuning as clean test work.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: research. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Keep one sealed opening/exposure guard and preregistered frozen comparison rules. This is a claim gate, not a shipping gate. No final-test read occurred in this planning exercise.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 3 Final freeze and one test opening.

Shipping the library and earning a superiority claim are separate gates. This is the claim gate.

Scope:
Freeze, one opening per sealed corpus, readout.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A release-candidate manifest is committed before any test output: code, model and prompt hashes; every compared configuration and baseline; calibration fits; decoder, fill and abstention settings; task estimands and weights; exclusions; primary contrasts and their effect targets; multiplicity treatment; CI methods; power assumptions.
2. The shipping configuration was selected on development data before the freeze.
3. Baselines and frozen ablations run in the same final batch.
4. Each sealed corpus is opened once through the guarded final-opening mode; its read-count ledger goes from 0 to 1.
5. The readout compares results with the pre-declared effect targets and uncertainty, and states that lack of evidence for a gain is not evidence of equivalence.
6. No retuning after the opening; any later output-affecting change is labelled development work on a consumed test.
7. Failures and the original readout are preserved; an unavailable corpus or arm is recorded, not substituted.
8. Any superiority claim is scoped per track, per baselines actually run, per corpus.

Gate: fresh-context cold review of the committed text; the commit body states what changed and
what it does not establish.

Size: M.
